# Claimont Health

> > Claimont Health delivers specialist private mental health and complex care services through home-based treatment, live-in nursing, and psychiatric alternatives across the UK.

Claimont Health is a CQC-approved private healthcare provider offering personalized mental health treatment (depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, substance abuse) and complex neurological care (brain injury, cerebral palsy, learning disabilities) delivered in patients' homes. The service combines multidisciplinary teams, 24/7 live-in support options, and home visits as alternatives to psychiatric hospital admission.

## Mental Health Services

- [Private Adult Mental Health Treatment](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/adults): CQC-approved adult mental health treatment for depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and related conditions
- [Private Child & Adolescent Treatment](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/child-adolescent-mental-health-services): CQC-approved child and adolescent mental health treatment including eating disorders and behavioral support
- [Private Alcohol Detox at Home](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/home-alcohol-detox): CQC-approved private alcohol detoxification and withdrawal management delivered safely at home
- [Private Drug Detox at Home](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/home-drug-detox): CQC-approved private drug detox for benzodiazepines and substance abuse with clinical monitoring
- [Live-in Care Support For Mental Health](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/live-in-care): 24/7 live-in mental health nursing and psychiatric hospital alternative with intensive clinical support
- [Private Mental Health Support Home Visits](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/mental-health-services/home-visits): Daily or monthly mental health home visits with CBT therapy and clinical assessment

## Complex Care Services

- [Complex Care Overview](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/complex-care-services): Complex care for neurological conditions, brain injury, cerebral palsy, and specialized support needs
- [Acquired Brain Injury Support](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/complex-care-services/acquired-brain-injury): Acquired brain injury rehabilitation and cognitive support services with personalized care planning
- [Learning Disabilities Support](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/complex-care-services/learning-disabilities-support): Person-centered home care for learning disabilities and autism support with community integration
- [Cerebral Palsy Support](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/complex-care-services/cerebral-palsy-support): Personalized cerebral palsy care with physical and neurological support for daily living

## Home Care Services

- [Specialist Private Mental Health and Complex Physical & Neurological Support](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/private-individual): Private mental health and complex care services delivered at home with multidisciplinary teams
- [Private Live-In Home Care](https://claimonthealth.co.uk/private-individual/live-in-home-care): 24-hour live-in nursing and caregiving for complex care needs with clinical oversight
